# Casa dos Escritores

> A platform for writers to publish, share, and connect.

## Website Structure

- **Home**: https://casadosescritores.com.br/
  The main landing page featuring curated and trending content.

- **Series**: https://casadosescritores.com.br/series
  Collections of chapters forming a complete narrative or thematic series.

- **Explore**: https://casadosescritores.com.br/explorar
  Browse content by categories and tags.

- **About**: https://casadosescritores.com.br/about
  Information about the platform and its mission.

- **Guidelines**: https://casadosescritores.com.br/guidelines
  Community guidelines for writers and readers.

## Content Types

- **Series**: A collection of chapters.
- **Chapters**: Individual pieces of writing within a series.
- **Profiles**: User profiles showcasing their work and bio.

## For AI Agents

This site contains creative writing, fiction, and non-fiction.
Content is organized hierarchically: Writer -> Series -> Chapter.
